name: Halo Executive Conference Desk
description: Bring a luxurious corporate look to your workspace meeting areas with the Executive Halo Conference Desk. This sleek modern desk is a counter part to the Halo Executive Series. Perfect for luxury offices, business meeting rooms and professional workspace builds.
